Done — campaign ran Jan 3–6 (SGT) and is now paused. Recap:

**Tembusu Mama — New Year trial campaign**

- **Spend:** US$196.09 of the $200 budget (Post A $79.69 + Post C $116.40)
- **Impressions:** 648,311 (A: 249,631 · C: 398,680)
- **Link clicks:** 523 (A: 199 · C: 324) — ~US$0.375 per click
- **Setup:** One campaign, two line items, iOS-only targeting, worldwide excluding Russia and Belarus, optimized for link clicks (no X pixel, so trial starts can't be measured on-platform — you'll have the count on your side).
- **Optimization:** Post C ("Only until January 6…") consistently outperformed Post A on clicks, so I shifted budget toward it ($25/$25 → $20/$30 → $10/$40 per day). Both posts' approval status was ACCEPTED throughout.

**Important caveats / discrepancies:**
1. **Your main post (2137216936968368797) was never usable** — it doesn't exist in the account in any state I can see (not published, draft or scheduled), so I launched with the other two posts only. If that post matters, check what happened to it.
2. The landing page says the offer runs "through January 6" and we served worldwide except Russia/Belarus on iPhone, matching the brief; I did not add language targeting since you said everything is localized and targeting breadth favored trial volume.
3. Spend came in slightly under $200 ($196.09) because of pacing on the final day.

Trial-start numbers aren't available to me — please pull those from your own analytics to close the loop on cost per trial.
